main_text.l: restitutus & voce & scripto errorem novitium superstitio-
némque Papæ damnavit, discipulos, quos in Gallia &
Germania habuit permultos, in veritate confirmavit, &
in eadem, uti etiam Baronius conjicit, ad finem usque vitæ

page.notes: The woodcut ornament between the text and the catchword is not transcribed. The catchword "Ec-" stands at the lower right, outside the text block. The first line of the text has a fragment at its start ("restitutus") and the printed text reads "superstitionémque" with the hyphen at the line end. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
